I've been a diehard PC gamer all my life, but as someone who works 8 hours a day at a computer, sometimes I don't want to sit on a gaming chair and want to give my neck and shoulders a break. Whilst I could plug in a controller to my PC, I'd still have to use a keyboard and mouse occationally. And I'm not plugging my PC to my living room TV. #gaming
